requirements.title: System must enforce password complexity

descriptions.label: default
descriptions.data: The system must require passwords to contain at least 12 characters with uppercase, lowercase, numbers, and special characters.

descriptions.label: check
descriptions.data: Verify the 'minlen' setting in /etc/security/pwquality.conf is 12 or greater. Run: grep minlen /etc/security/pwquality.conf. If the value is less than 12 or is commented out, this is a finding.

descriptions.label: fix
descriptions.data: Configure the system to require a minimum password length of 12 characters. Add or edit the following line in /etc/security/pwquality.conf: minlen = 12

descriptions.label: rationale
descriptions.data: Longer passwords increase the time and computational resources required to compromise the password via brute force.

requirements.code:
control 'SV-123456' do
  impact 0.7
  describe file('/etc/security/pwquality.conf') do
    its('content') { should match /^minlen\s*=\s*(1[2-9]|[2-9][0-9])/ }
  end
end

descriptions.label: default
descriptions.data: All successful and failed authentication attempts must be logged.
